headline: Power Backup Report for Harris County
summary: Homes in Harris County face a long outage about once every 5 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In July 2024, 91% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 175 hours. In May 2024, 27% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 140 hours. One Core lasts about 17 hours in August. Two Cores last about 35 hours in August. Base confirms sizing at install.
